name: Earth-Friendly Card grants (地球にやさしいカード助成事業)
summary: Grants to groups working on nature conservation and related research, paid from donations tied to a credit card scheme. Grants normally last one year (April to March) and can be continued after review.
reporting: A financial statement and an activity report at the end of the grant period.
